scope: Single-seed train8 diagnostic. Document-only clustering pending higher source-group recovery. Never formal noninferiority or factual correctness.

0.1.scope: development diagnostic; never a formal noninferiority claim
0.1.score_unit: fraction; multiply by 100 for percentage points
0.1.method: paired percentile cluster bootstrap; same draws for both methods; seeds averaged within each question before resampling whole clusters
assumptions: Supplied clusters are independent; this function cannot verify that assumption.
All frozen questions, seeds, parse failures and service failures must be supplied by the caller.
Confidence intervals do not correct post-hoc method/budget selection or establish factual quality.
Unequal-cluster micro intervals target question-weighted performance; equal-cluster intervals target a different estimand.

no_observed_cluster_loss_sensitivity.limit: Exact zero-event Bernoulli sensitivity assumes iid cluster loss events; bounds an event probability, not the question-weighted effect. It is not substituted for the primary interval.

0.1.replicate_label_note: Replicate0 is the sole experiment seed family; resolved sampling seeds vary by question and are checked equal across paired methods.
